summary.text: Juan Hinojosa is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 32, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Republican incumbent Brian Hodgers.

paragraphs.text: Hinojosa ran for District 32 in 2024 and lost the general election to Republican Debbie Mayfield, receiving 35.7% of the vote.
He was the Democratic nominee in the June 10, 2025 special general election for the seat, which Brian Hodgers won with 55.3% of the vote to Hinojosa's 44.7%.
